image_description: A close-up, high-contrast image of a cooked Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally against a dark background. The crab is viewed from the ventral side (underside), displaying its white/cream-colored abdomen and leg joints, with the reddish-orange tips of the claws and legs visible. The carapace is partially obscured by the angle and lighting, but the characteristic broad shape and limb arrangement are evident. There appears to be some glossy reflection on the shell, indicating a wet or cooked texture.
